baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated prohibition is followed by two conduct clauses and then by the positive pair an tabarruhum wa-tuqsitu ilayhim.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah does more than suspend hostility. The absence of mutual fighting and forced exit opens an active field in which kin-like care and equity are directed toward the same people; restraint is the gate, while beneficence and justice are the resulting practices.

activation_trace.role: The literal image of restraining or forbidding supplies the legal gate whose negation opens, rather than exhausts, the ethical field.
Mutual fighting between parties supplies the first observable threshold whose absence defines the addressees of positive treatment.
Passage out from a settled place supplies forced displacement as the second conduct threshold.
Residence and attachment to a dwelling make the protected object a lived home relation, not merely movable property.
Kin-directed connection and beneficence supply an active, relation-building response rather than bare nonaggression.
Justice and fair dealing supply the public norm that disciplines benevolence and prevents it from becoming partial favor.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely tolerates peaceful outsiders by withholding a ban.
changed_reading.after: Withholding the ban opens a positive practice of beneficence and equity toward people defined by what they have not done, not by group sameness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root q-s-t appears first as the commanded action tuqsitu and again in the agent noun al-muqsitin, immediately after divine love.
baseline_models.mechanism: Equity moves from an event to a durable agent identity. Its share, balance, and measure images make the practice calibrated rather than vaguely nice, while birr requires truth to pass into action; divine love marks sustained equitable agency, not a single neutral decision.

activation_trace.role: An apportioned share supplies the distributive unit by which equitable treatment becomes concrete.
The straight balance supplies calibration and correction as the form of the repeated action.
Measure and quantity make the transition from abstract fairness to inspectable proportion.
Truth carried through speech and deed supplies fidelity between professed principle and actual treatment.
Love abiding in the heart supplies the evaluative force that attaches to people formed as equitable agents.

changed_reading.before: Qist is a one-off requirement to be evenhanded in this encounter.
changed_reading.after: The action is meant to form a recognizable kind of person: one who repeatedly allocates, measures, and corrects relations equitably.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired phrases fi al-din and min diyarikum place fighting over religious adherence beside removal from inhabited space.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah protects two interiors: the sphere of religious obedience and the sphere of dwelling. The decisive distinction is not religious difference itself but coercive combat in the first sphere and forced extraction from the second.

activation_trace.role: Obedience and religious adherence supply the first sphere in which coercive conflict is denied.
Subjugation and imposed mastery expose the coercive alternative that the non-fighting clause excludes.
Reciprocal warfare supplies the overt coercive mechanism in the religious sphere.
Exit from a settled condition supplies the rupture of the spatial interior.
Encirclement and boundedness give the dwelling a protected spatial contour.

changed_reading.before: Religious difference is itself the social boundary that kindness exceptionally crosses.
changed_reading.after: The boundary is crossed by coercion and displacement; religious difference without those acts remains inside the field of beneficence and equity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier warning binds responsible patronage to secretly casting affection toward active adversaries. Against that configuration, the focus ayah's birr and qist become overt public ethics that do not automatically transfer strategic trust, guardianship, or inside access.

activation_trace.role: Open connection and beneficence supply care that can be rendered without assigning political custody.
Public justice supplies the accountable mode that distinguishes ethical treatment from covert partiality.
Taking charge of an affair supplies the stronger patronage relation that the focus commands need not confer.
Casting something toward another supplies the directional transfer of affection into the prohibited channel.
Affection supplies the relational content whose covert placement, not kindness as such, is under warning.
Concealment in the interior supplies secrecy as the feature separating hidden allegiance from inspectable birr and qist.

structural_cues: 60:1 couples taking adversaries as awliya with casting affection and hiding it, while 60:8 names overt beneficence and equity toward a conduct-defined group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covert affection inside wilaya in 60:1 and overt birr/qist in 60:8; I infer distinct relational channels, so public justice need not grant strategic guardianship. A live alternative is that these are degrees of one attachment rather than categorically separate relations.

changed_reading.before: Kindness toward an outside group risks being read as the same relation as intimate alliance.
changed_reading.after: The ayah authorizes a public ethic of care and equity while leaving strategic patronage and confidential access bounded.

context_deltas.mechanism: Manifest enmity and inward antipathy are followed by the possibility that God will make affection between the parties. The focus practices can therefore occupy the interval before affection exists: beneficence and equity preserve a relation in which hostility is not treated as an immutable essence.

activation_trace.role: Relation-building beneficence supplies a practice capable of keeping a closed relation from becoming final.
Abiding love supplies the focus ayah's positive affective horizon for equitable action.
Explicit enmity supplies the starting relation whose apparent permanence is later reopened.
The soul's aversion, opposed to love, supplies the affective depth of the initial rupture.
Making something become a new state supplies transformation rather than mere discovery of affection already present.
Affection supplies the possible future state toward which non-hostile relations can turn.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from declared enmity in 60:4, through possible made-affection in 60:7, directly into the conduct rule of 60:8.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a changed relation made by God and then commands human birr/qist; I infer that these practices can preserve the social conditions in which transformation becomes livable. The live alternative is that divine making alone causes the affection and the human practices are consequences, not contributing conditions.

changed_reading.before: Beneficence follows only after hostility has already ended and affection has appeared.
changed_reading.after: Beneficence and equity can precede affection, holding open a future for transformed relations without pretending present boundaries have vanished.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context denies ultimate efficacy to womb-relations and offspring and announces separation between people, while the focus uses a branch of birr marked by kin-like care for noncombatants across the group boundary. Kinship's ethical intensity is retained, but genealogical membership loses control of its destination.

activation_trace.role: Care opposed to severing kin supplies the intensity of treatment now directed beyond genealogy.
Womb and kinship supply the genealogical bond whose ultimate privilege is explicitly denied.
Offspring by descent intensify the natural bond that nevertheless cannot determine the final relation.
Separation that exposes a boundary supplies the judgment that blood ties cannot erase distinctions.

structural_cues: 60:3 negates the benefit of kin and children before 60:8 directs a kin-colored verb of care toward a conduct-defined outside group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies genealogical bonds stripped of ultimate privilege and a focus branch of kin-like beneficence; I infer a transfer of ethical intensity without a transfer of genealogical status. The alternative is that the kin branch is only a lexical analogy and carries no deliberate transposition here.

changed_reading.before: Birr is generalized kindness modeled weakly on family care.
changed_reading.after: The ayah detaches family-grade care from blood privilege and redirects it by conduct, even while preserving real group boundaries.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah mirrors prohibition, fighting, expulsion, and dwellings, then adds active support for expulsion and names the prohibited relation as wilaya. The pair forms a conduct-sensitive classification: absent aggression opens birr/qist; aggression, displacement, or material backing for them closes the patronage channel.

activation_trace.role: The negated image of forbidding supplies the open side of the adjacent classification.
Expansive good supplies the positive practice assigned to the open side.
Equity supplies the norm governing treatment on the open side.
The positive prohibition supplies the closed side of the mirrored classification.
Mutual warfare supplies the first enacted condition that closes patronage.
Removal from settled place, repeated in the verse, supplies displacement as a decisive condition.
Residence in a dwelling supplies the concrete relation violated by expulsion.
Strengthening another with one's back and aid expands responsibility from direct expulsion to material support for it.
Taking charge of another's affair identifies patronage, rather than all decent treatment, as the relation prohibited on the closed side.
Withholding another's right supplies the diagnosis of crossing the now-explicit boundary.

structural_cues: 60:9 begins with innama and repeats the key syntax and roots of 60:8 while reversing the polarity and adding support for expulsion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact adjacent lexical mirror plus an added aiding clause; I infer that the verses are complementary classifications organized by conduct. A live alternative is that innama narrowly limits only the wilaya prohibition, while the positive force of birr/qist remains permission or commendation rather than a symmetrical duty.

changed_reading.before: Peaceful outsiders are an exception carved out of a generally hostile group category.
changed_reading.after: Conduct is the hinge: nonaggression and nondisplacement open positive treatment, while fighting, expulsion, and support for expulsion close patronage without licensing indiscriminate mistreatment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later rules repeatedly require giving back expenditures, reciprocal claims, adjudication, and replacement equal to what was lost. These operations activate qist's share and measure branches: cross-boundary equity is not only a fair attitude but a restorative ledger that survives relational rupture.

activation_trace.role: The apportioned share supplies the unit restored to a party after a relationship changes.
Measure and quantity supply the exactness required for reciprocal settlement.
Giving supplies the outward transfer by which an acknowledged share is actually restored.
Money gone out in expenditure supplies the amount that the settlement tracks across parties.
Mutual asking supplies reciprocal standing to make claims rather than a one-directional favor.
Judgment between people supplies the public procedure that stabilizes reciprocal claims.
Loss beyond reach supplies the deficit that calls for restorative action.
A substitute or guarantee supplies replacement as the response to the deficit.
Equivalence supplies the ratio that limits compensation to the like of what was expended.
The repeated expenditure image closes the ledger by naming the amount to be matched.

structural_cues: 60:10 repeats giving, spending, and reciprocal asking; 60:11 then specifies compensation equal to what was spent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concrete reciprocal accounting after marriage and community boundaries change; I infer that this operationalizes the focus root q-s-t by analogy. The alternative is that these financial rules are local settlements and should not define the full semantic range of qist in 60:8.

changed_reading.before: Equity means a generally fair disposition toward peaceful outsiders.
changed_reading.after: Equity can require measurable restitution, reciprocal claim-rights, and compensation even after intimate or communal relations rupture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pledge in 60:12 binds participants to non-disobedience in recognized good and then pairs acceptance with forgiveness. This activates birr as truth enacted and qist as a publicly legible norm: conduct can be covenanted, inspected, and repaired after failure rather than left as private sentiment.

activation_trace.role: Truth that carries through word and deed supplies fidelity to an ethical undertaking.
Justice supplies the public criterion against which undertaken conduct can be assessed.
A pledge of obedience supplies the explicit public form in which conduct is undertaken.
Departure from obedience supplies the breach against which the pledged norm is defined.
Good recognized by conscience, reason, and norm supplies a shared criterion rather than private preference.
Covering fault while protecting its bearer from its effect supplies repair after accountable failure.

structural_cues: 60:12 frames recognized good inside a repeated pledge and follows the pledge with a request for forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a public undertaking, a recognized norm, and post-breach forgiveness; I infer an accountable-and-reparative shape for birr/qist. The alternative is that 60:12 governs an internal covenant and only analogically illuminates cross-boundary treatment in 60:8.

changed_reading.before: Birr and qist are admirable private dispositions toward individuals.
changed_reading.after: They can function as public, recognizable commitments that remain answerable to breach and open to repair.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the terrestrial branch of b-r-r inside a moral verb. It remains anchored by the focus ayah's dwellings, expulsion, and straight-balance images; downstream prose should mark it as a spatial analogy for civic coexistence, not as a replacement translation of tabarruhum.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sequence from expulsion out of dwellings to tabarruhum and tuqsitu allows the land, home, and balance branches to form one spatial mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Dry land and open terrain supply a shared civic ground on which relations can remain traversable.
Forced passage outside supplies the spatial injury that makes shared ground ethically consequential.
Encircled dwelling-space supplies the homes between which a viable civic terrain must be maintained.
The straight balance supplies the leveling and alignment that keep the shared terrain usable.

changed_reading.before: The verse regulates only interpersonal kindness toward peaceful others.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also imagines maintaining a just civic ground between homes so that difference does not become expulsion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because it combines grain, seed, apportioned share, and made-affection as a material analogy. It remains anchored in the focus sequence birr-qist-love and the immediately preceding possibility of affection; downstream prose should present it as an activation about how concrete provision may cultivate relation, never as the lexical meaning of the verbs.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Tabarruhum, tuqsitu, and yuhibbu occur as a sequence of giving-good, equitable allocation, and love.

activation_trace.role: Wheat and grain supply tangible sustenance as the material form that beneficence can take.
An apportioned share supplies equitable distribution of the material good.
A seed that grows and bears love supplies cultivation as the directional image linking provision to future relation.
Making or bringing something into being supplies the emergence of a relation not yet present.
Affection supplies the possible fruit toward which material care and fair sharing point.

changed_reading.before: Divine love simply rewards an already complete act of abstract fairness.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, concrete provision fairly shared can act like seed, cultivating the future affection that the context holds possible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates q-s-t's scattered-groups branch and turns repeated separation/between language into social topology. It remains anchored in the double q-s-t occurrence and the context's explicit boundaries; downstream prose should qualify it as a model of plural ordering, not claim that al-muqsitin literally means group arrangers.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled q-s-t root can be read against the context's repeated concern with separation and what stands between distinct parties.

activation_trace.role: Scattered groups supply plurality as the social material justice must order without erasing.
The straight balance supplies a fair relation among differentiated groups rather than forced sameness.
Separation that reveals a boundary supplies differentiation as a real feature of the social field.
The interval between two sides supplies the relational space in which affection or equity can be made.
A connection standing between parties supplies linkage that does not require their boundaries to disappear.

changed_reading.before: Justice treats everyone the same by ignoring group boundaries.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, justice arranges fair spacing and connection among distinct groups, preserving difference while preventing the boundary from becoming violence.

strongest_changes: The exact 60:8-60:9 mirror makes fighting, displacement, and support for displacement the conduct hinge rather than religious identity alone.
The contrast with covert wilaya in 60:1 separates public beneficence and equity from strategic patronage or confidential access.
The reciprocal payments of 60:10-60:11 activate qist as measurable restitution and claim-rights after relational rupture.
The movement from kin separation and declared enmity to possible affection lets family-grade care cross genealogy and precede reconciliation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah sustained several coexisting mechanisms: a conduct-gated positive ethic, formation of an equitable agent, protection of religious and domestic interiors, restorative accounting, and more exploratory spatial and cultivation images. The context did not collapse these into either unrestricted alliance or bare tolerance.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntax clearly opens birr and qist, but the precise force among permission, commendation, and obligation remains live.
The mirrored threshold securely names fighting and expulsion; how far coercive aggression short of fighting belongs under it is unresolved.
The compensation rules strongly illuminate qist by analogy, but their local legal scope may be narrower than the focus ayah's full ethic.
The terrain, seed, and social-spacing readings are productive branch activations and should remain explicitly exploratory.
